run_script_local_db_load_data: run the mephisto local_db load_data script to load data into the mephisto database
run_script_mturk_cleanup: run the mephisto mturk cleanup script to clean up mturk resources and HITs
run_script_metrics_view: run the mephisto metrics view script to launch and view metrics servers
